what: Fortive makes industrial and healthcare technology. After spinning off its precision technologies business it focuses on facility and asset management software, environmental and safety instruments, and hospital sterilisation and workflow products.
customers: Facility and utility operators, industrial safety teams, hospitals and surgical centres.
money: facility and asset management software, safety and utility instruments
sterilisation, surgical workflow and hospital software
moat: Software and instruments embedded in facility and hospital workflows, with recurring subscriptions and consumables rather than one-off equipment sales.
risks: Revenue grew only about 2% last year and has fallen about 11% a year over three years after spin-offs
Debt of about $3.6 billion against little cash
Return on invested capital of about 7% reflects goodwill from acquisitions
Analyst targets imply the shares are already fully valued
opportunities: Gross margin of 64% with a growing share of recurring software revenue
The spin-off leaves a simpler, higher-margin company
Hospital procedure volumes continue to grow
watch: Core revenue growth and the share of recurring revenue.
